title: Bank or card statement for PF reconciliation (R-REC-1)

institution.description: Bank or card issuer name as printed.

account_hint.description: Account name or last digits as printed, e.g. 'Visa ...9876'.

period_start.description: First day of the statement period, YYYY-MM-DD.

period_end.description: Last day of the statement period, YYYY-MM-DD.

opening_balance.description: Opening or previous balance exactly as printed, e.g. '1,764.30'. Copy it; do not change its sign.

closing_balance.description: Closing or new balance exactly as printed.

total_credits.description: Printed total of credits or deposits, if the statement shows one.

total_debits.description: Printed total of debits or purchases, if the statement shows one.

lines.description: Every transaction line on the statement, in printed order.

post_date.description: Posting date, YYYY-MM-DD, when the statement shows both dates.

amount.description: Signed by what the line IS: money spent or owed more is negative; money received, paid to a card or refunded is positive. Use the section heading and marks like CR, - or brackets, not the column.

section.description: The heading the line sits under, copied exactly as printed (e.g. 'Payments and Credits').

reference.description: Reference or check number, if printed.
